faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers. If you can't find it here, our 24/7 support is ready to help.

questions.question: Is the first resume really free? What's the catch?
questions.answer: Yes, 100% free. The catch is that we're confident you'll love the result so much you'll want to unlock the full power of CareerStudio Pro. You can create your profile, generate your first ATS-optimized resume, and download it as a PDF without ever entering a credit card.

questions.question: How is this different from a simple template builder?
questions.answer: Templates just give you a layout. CareerStudio is an intelligent system. Our AI doesn't just fill blanks—it understands your career, suggests powerful phrasing, optimizes every line for ATS bots, and helps you tailor your entire application to a specific job in seconds. It’s a writing partner, not just a document.

questions.question: What is ATS and why is it so important?
questions.answer: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is automated software that scans your resume for keywords and formatting before a human ever sees it. Over 75% of resumes are rejected by these bots. We meticulously design and structure every resume to be perfectly parsed by ATS, guaranteeing your application lands in front of a real person.

questions.question: Can I cancel my Pro plan at any time?
questions.answer: Absolutely. You are in complete control. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your account dashboard with a single click. No hidden fees, no hassle. You will retain access to Pro features until the end of your current billing period.

questions.question: Who is this platform for? Students? Executives?
questions.answer: CareerStudio is designed for anyone serious about their career. It's powerful enough for executives targeting competitive roles, yet simple enough for recent graduates to build their first professional resume. If you're tired of the repetitive, frustrating job application process, CareerStudio is for you.

questions.question: What happens to my portfolio website if I cancel my Pro plan?
questions.answer: If you cancel your Pro plan, your portfolio website will be unpublished and the shareable link will no longer be active. All your data and designs will be safely stored, and you can republish it instantly if you ever decide to resubscribe.
